generated_for: Chris Birch Surfboards official named standup catalog
source: https://www.surfboardsbychrisbirch.com/models (official Wix model lineup — named production shapes only)

brands.name: Chris Birch Surfboards
brands.short_description: American-made custom surfboards by Chris Birch, shaped in his Satellite Beach, Florida factory — shortboards, fishes, mid-lengths, and longboards from a shaper who has been building boards on the Space Coast since 1978.

models.name: Accelerator
models.description: The #1 seller and the model Chris Birch rides. Generates speed with ease and works well in 2 ft. to overhead surf. Comes with his quad fin set. Pictured 6'4" — nose 15 3/4", center 21 3/4", tail 17".

models.name: Accelerator II
models.description: Same outline as the Accelerator, but with a fish tail. Can be ordered as a twin, tri, or quad fin (quad preferred). Pictured 6'2" — nose 15 7/8", center 21 1/2", tail 17 1/2".

models.name: Afishionado
models.description: Chris Birch's most retro fish outline. A wide template combined with flatter rocker and thickness throughout allows the rider to go shorter than his everyday board. Pictured 5'8" — nose 18 1/8", center 21 1/2", tail 17 1/4".

models.name: Sweet Pea
models.description: Mini-Simmons influenced, for the surfer who wants to push the limits of shortness. Can be ordered as twin or quad fin. Pictured 5'2" — nose 19", center 21 1/2", tail 17 1/2".

models.name: Element
models.description: Rocket Fish outline, based off of Chris Birch's love for Mark Richards twin-fins of the 1980's. Can be ordered as twin, tri, or quad fin. Pictured 5'8" — nose 14", center 20 3/8", tail 15 7/8".

models.name: Chauffeur
models.description: Combines performance longboarding with nose-ridability. A great all-around longboard. Pictured 9'1" — nose 18 1/8", center 22 1/2", tail 14".

models.name: Mini Chauffeur
models.description: The ease of paddling and wave catchability of a longboard in a shorter version of the Chauffeur. Pictured 7'8" — nose 18 1/4", center 21 3/4", tail 14 1/2".

models.name: Cousin Dupree
models.description: Classic outline with flatter rocker for a smooth, easy ride — just plain fun. Pictured 7'2" — nose 16 3/4", center 21 5/8", tail 14 1/2".

models.name: Soloist
models.description: Old-school slightly forward outline with modernized rocker and thickness flow. Versatile outline that can be ordered with any fin set-up. Pictured 6'4" — nose 14", wide point 20 1/2", tail 14 1/2".

models.name: Rabble Rouser
models.description: Chris Birch's standard performance thruster, built with a single-to-double concave bottom. Pictured 6'0" — nose 11 3/4", center 19 1/2", tail 15".

models.name: Velocity
models.description: Chris Birch has been building this model since the early 1990's. Extreme down-the-line speed. Pictured 6'3" — nose 12 1/2", center 20 1/2", tail 16 1/4".

models.name: Buford Stick
models.description: More emphasis on cruising and noseriding. Wider throughout than the Chauffeur. Pictured 9'4" — nose 19 5/8", center 23 1/4", tail 14 5/8".

models.name: Garrett Spencer
models.description: This single-fin longboard is designed to turn well off the tail and noseride in the pocket. Fast and responsive, it adds a modern touch to this classic-inspired board. Pictured 9'6" — nose 17", center 23", tail 16".
